evidence_items.explanation: Sutton explicitly places reinforcement learning at the center of his conception of AI. The surrounding discussion contrasts learning through consequences with imitating human language.

Sutton distinguishes predicting environmental consequences from predicting what a person would say. This supports the shared emphasis on grounded world models, while showing why 'limitations of prediction' needs the language-prediction qualification.
